module_summary: Multi-cycle IEEE-754 single-precision multiplier sequenced by a free-running 3-bit step counter: unpack, special-case check, normalize, multiply mantissas, round, pack.

anchors.name: n9_47f
anchors.why: 3-bit step sequencer selecting unpack, special, normalize, multiply, extract, round and pack phases

anchors.name: n4_113
anchors.why: First 32-bit float operand unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa

anchors.name: n11_144
anchors.why: Second 32-bit float operand unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa

anchors.name: n18_dfc
anchors.why: 32-bit float product output, packed from result sign, exponent, mantissa or special NaN/Inf/zero

anchors.name: n8_4bb
anchors.why: 50-bit mantissa product computed in multiply phase

anchors.name: n5_c26
anchors.why: Operand A mantissa with hidden bit, normalized by shifting before multiplication

anchors.name: n3_f38
anchors.why: Operand B mantissa with hidden bit, normalized by shifting before multiplication

anchors.name: n19_d34
anchors.why: Result exponent sum, adjusted by denormal shift, normalization and rounding overflow

anchors.name: n17_bde
anchors.why: Result mantissa extracted from product, normalized and rounded before packing

anchors.name: n15_077
anchors.why: Unbiased exponent of operand A, decremented during normalization

anchors.name: n13_9cf
anchors.why: Unbiased exponent of operand B, decremented during normalization

anchors.name: n0_b44
anchors.why: Operand A sign bit; XORed with operand B sign for result sign

anchors.name: n14_7c6
anchors.why: Result sign, XOR of operand signs, packed into output bit 31

anchors.name: n7_e94
anchors.why: Guard bit from product; with round and sticky bits decides round-up increment

groups.name: step sequencer
groups.description: Free-running counter whose value selects the active computation phase

groups.name: operand unpack
groups.description: Splits operands into sign, unbiased exponent and normalized mantissa

groups.name: multiply and round
groups.description: Mantissa product, exponent add, guard/round/sticky rounding and normalization

groups.name: result pack
groups.description: Packs result or special NaN/Inf/zero encodings into 32-bit output
